entries.1d69bdf513f9124a: This reportable segment mainly serves the automotive and MaaS (services that provide transportation as a bundle) markets and the markets for three-dimensional DX in local governments, civil engineering and construction, and it has the largest sales to external customers. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 18.6% from the previous fiscal year. It sells MMS (devices mounted on vehicles that measure roads and townscapes in three dimensions) measuring instruments and related products, undertakes three-dimensional measurement and analysis using MMS and the building of high-precision three-dimensional map databases, undertakes the construction of autonomous driving systems and demonstration tests, and provides satellite positioning services and other services. The consolidated subsidiary Surido Co., Ltd. handles three-dimensional measurement, and A-Drive Co., Ltd. (the company holds 60% of its voting rights; a specified subsidiary) handles the social implementation of autonomous driving. The annual securities report states that both sales and segment profit grew substantially because of an increase in the number of orders received and cost reductions.

entries.c1b4b50a4a969779: This reportable segment mainly serves the surveying and real estate markets. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 27.1% from the previous fiscal year. It sells software and maintenance services for surveying and civil engineering, processing software for three-dimensional point clouds (large volumes of positional data measured by lasers and other means), and measuring instruments for surveying with their maintenance services, and also undertakes land, river and marine surveys. The consolidated subsidiary Sanwa Co., Ltd. undertakes surveying work, and Akisoku Limited Company serves as a sales outlet for the company's products. entries.eb018d7eba01d94c: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 69.2% from the previous year, ordinary profit rose 71.0%, and profit attributable to owners of the parent rose 82.4%. The operating margin on revenue rose from 7.2% in the previous year to 10.0%. The MD&A of the annual securities report cites, as factors behind the margin improvement, a higher share of sales of high value-added in-house products, and efficiency gains in cost of sales and selling, general and administrative expenses through the use of generative AI and in-sourcing of operations. The company also states that, based on the investigation report of the Special Investigation Committee on suspected improper transactions and misconduct at its consolidated subsidiary, Yugen-gaisha Akiyoshi, it verified prior-period accounting treatment, examined in detail the amount of the impact on the consolidated financial statements, and reflected this in the annual securities report.
